programme.title: Žogarija
programme.desc: Žogarija je projekt, ki uteleša eno naših najpomembnejših prepričanj – da šport lahko izboljša kakovost življenja mladih. Žogarija: harmonija generacij je serija oddaj, ki skozi pristne zgodbe in pogovore povezuje otroke, starše in stare starše. Vsaka oddaja prikazuje medgeneracijsko sodelovanje, igre, ustvarjalnost in vrednote družine v središču lokalnega dogajanja. Gre za toplo, življenjsko serijo, ki spodbuja povezanost in aktivno skupnost.

programme.title: Reportaža
programme.desc: Tedenska predstavitev vsebin iz lokalnega okolja. Voditeljica Špela Pokeržnik gosti športnike, glasbenike, politike in vodje društev. Usodne volitve – kaj vmesne volitve v ZDA pomenijo za Avstrijo? Svet 3. novembra z napetostjo zre v ZDA. Na polovici drugega mandata Donalda Trumpa so na sporedu vmesne volitve – znova se voli predstavniški dom in del senata. Kakšne posledice – politične, gospodarske in družbene – gre pričakovati? Podoba ZDA se je v Avstriji v zadnjem času spremenila – od "najljubše okupacijske sile", ki nam je prinesla mir, svoboden tisk, pakete pomoči Care, kavbojke in demokracijo, do vse bolj nepredvidljivega partnerja. Ulla Kramar-Schmid in Sabina Riedl raziskujeta, kako so se spremenili odnosi Avstrije z ZDA in kakšno stališče ima danes avstrijska politika do Donalda Trumpa. Živčnost pred deželnimi volitvami. V zveznih deželah stranke ÖVP vlada strah. Štajersko so že izgubili proti svobodnjakom, v Zgornji Avstriji in na Tirolskem pa je FPÖ v anketah že izenačena z Ljudsko stranko. S tem narašča živčnost pred deželnimi volitvami, predvolilni boji pa so se že začeli. Krivca za slabe rezultate so deželne organizacije ÖVP hitro našle: lastno zvezno stranko in delo v zvezni vladi. In tako se že začenja distanciranje, zbadanje in pošiljanje nasvetov proti zvezni ravni. Deželni glavarji ÖVP vse glasneje zahtevajo več in hitrejše reforme od zvezne vlade. Tirolska ÖVP gre zdaj celo korak dlje in želi z lastnim članstvom na Tirolskem preprečiti, da bi člani morali hkrati postati člani zvezne ÖVP. Kaj se dogaja v zveznih deželah? Kako daleč gredo poskusi distanciranja od nepriljubljene trojne koalicije na zvezni ravni? In ali se po SPÖ zdaj tudi ÖVP bliža razpravi o vodstvu stranke? Laura Franz in Patrick Gruska se podajata po sledeh dogajanja. V intervjuju: deželni glavar Zgornje Avstrije Thomas Stelzer, ÖVP. Nov zakon – podobne težave. Že en mesec električni skiroji, ki so še posebej priljubljeni med dostavljavci hrane, ne smejo več voziti po kolesarskih stezah. To naj bi po zagotovilih zakonodajalca izboljšalo prometno varnost. Toda prva ocena je mešana. Dostavljavci se zdaj ne vozijo več z električnimi skiroji, ampak z električnimi kolesi. Drago kupljenimi ali najetimi, a vsaj nekoliko počasnejšimi. Na kolesarskih stezah torej ostaja tesno, prekarni delovni pogoji dostavljavcev pa so se še dodatno zaostrili. Poročilo Barbare Krivanek in Martina Puscha.

programme.title: Playing Lessons From the Pros: Kamaiu Johnson
programme.desc: Playing Lessons From the Pros (Sports). Imagine playing a casual round of golf with a legendary player such as Jack Nicklaus, Arnold Palmer, Nick Faldo, Ray Floyd, Colin Montgomerie, Juli Inkster and Laura Davies? Those are just a few of the former greats and current stars of the PGA and LPGA tours who have taken viewers inside the ropes as they make their way around a course, discussing such things as shot setup, club selection, strategy and other helpful hints and tips. It's a priceless lesson, a chance to dissect a pro's thought process as he or she executes all manner of shots

programme.title: Cyclisme : Liège-Bastogne-Liège
programme.desc: Pour cette 112e édition de Liège-Bastogne-Liège, le parcours de la "Doyenne" est quelque peu modifié par rapport à l'année dernière, tout en conservant onze côtes répertoriées. Dans le final, le parcours de 259,5 km se dote d'une difficulté supplémentaire, la côte du Maquisard qui n'avait plus été escaladée depuis 2020. Qui succédera au palmarès au Slovène Tadej Pogacar, vainqueur à Liège en 2021, 2024 et 2025 ?

MLB Tonight
programme.desc: MLB Tonight (Sports). When they're not tuning in to the games themselves, baseball fans know where to turn for their nightly baseball fix. MLB Network's signature program, «MLB Tonight» presents complete coverage of all of the games, beginning with the first pitch on the East Coast and ending with the final out on the West Coast. The Emmy-winning studio show features highlights, live look-ins and breaking news, plus analysis from a rotating roster of hosts, former players and inside information men

programme.title: Intentional Talk: Final Show
programme.desc: Intentional Talk (Sports). MLB Network's first-ever talk show is an open forum that features some talk and a lot of banter each weekday for host Kevin Millar, who discusses with special guests what's hot and what's not in and around the national pastime. He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. Millar gained fame as a member of the 2004 world champion Boston Red Sox, and since he retired from the diamond his knowledge of the game and warm, affable personality have vaulted him into a lengthy career in the media

programme.title: ⋗ Hot Stove
programme.desc: Hot Stove (Sports). Baby, it might be cold outside, and the springtime sounds of bats hitting balls are months away. What better way for baseball fans to cure the winter blues than to gather around the «Hot Stove» and warm up to the news of the offseason? MLB Network has all the angles covered for all 30 teams, from trades and free agent signings to the juicy rumors that percolate throughout, especially at the annual Winter Meetings in December. A host of former players, including Joe Magrane, Al Leiter, Sean Casey and Dan Plesac, analyze the news, supplemented by insider information from journalists Jon Heyman, Tom Verducci and Peter Gammons, among others

programme.desc: Get Up (Sports). ESPN's morning show features host Mike Greenberg with a rotating and diverse group of analysts opining about and analyzing the latest news from the world of sports. The two-hour, personality-driven show originates from Manhattan's South Street Seaport, a locale that attracts high-profile guests. Greenberg, aka «Greeny,» is formerly one-half of ESPN Radio's longtime «Mike Mike» morning show

programme.title: ⋗ First Take
programme.desc: First Take (Sports). Stephen A. Smith joins host Molly Qerim on this weekday morning sports debate show. Smith provides his expert takes on the day's trending sports topics and under-the-radar news. They're regularly joined by veteran analysts and the top guests in sports and entertainment

programme.title: ⋗ The Pat McAfee Show
programme.desc: The Pat McAfee Show (Sports). Former NFL punter Pat McAfee brings his humor and candor to the microphone to highlight the day's top stories

programme.title: ⋗ Bussin' Pate On Campus
programme.desc: Bussin' Pate On Campus (Sports). College football analyst Josh Pate and the «Bussin' with the Boys» crew preview this week's college football action

programme.title: ⋗ NBA Today
programme.desc: NBA Today (Sports). In-depth, comprehensive daily coverage of all aspects of the NBA from expert analysts

programme.title: ⋗ NFL Live
programme.desc: NFL Live (Sports). Host Laura Rutledge takes the helm of this weekday show featuring the likes of Marcus Spears, Dan Orlovsky, Mina Kimes, and Adam Schefter. The «NFL Live» crew entertains fans while offering all the latest news and analysis from across the NFL

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ Pardon the Interruption
programme.desc: Pardon the Interruption (Sports). The debate is the story in this fast-paced, half-hour series hosted by former Washington Post sportswriters Tony Kornheiser and Michael Wilbon. The pair engage in high-energy discussions, conduct interviews and often argue over topics not even related to sports. Other sports reporters appear as guests and offer opinions on the top stories of the day

programme.desc: Qui va revêtir le maillot arc-en-ciel et succéder au palmarès au Slovène Tadej Pogacar ? En l'absence de ce dernier, blessé lors du Tour d'Espagne, les favoris pour le titre sont les Belges Remco Evenepoel et Wout van Aert, et le Néerlandais Mathieu van der Poel. Mais une quinzaine de coureurs peuvent également rêver du maillot arc-en-ciel, à l'image du jeune prodige français Paul Seixas, de l'Equatorien Richard Carapaz ou encore de l'Espagnol Isaac Del Toro.

programme.desc: Pour cette 112e édition de Liège-Bastogne-Liège, le parcours de la "Doyenne" est quelque peu modifié par rapport à l'année dernière, tout en conservant onze côtes répertoriées. Dans le final, le parcours de 259,5 km se dote d'une difficulté supplémentaire, la côte du Maquisard qui n'avait plus été escaladée depuis 2020. Qui succédera au palmarès au Slovène Tadej Pogacar, vainqueur à Liège en 2021, 2024 et 2025 ?

Les Français Mejdi Schalck et Samuel Richard viseront une place sur le podium.

programme.title: Intentional Talk: Final Show

MLB Network's first-ever talk show is an open forum that features some talk and a lot of banter each weekday for host Kevin Millar, who discusses with special guests what's hot and what's not in and around the national pastime. He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. programme.title: ⋗ Hot Stove
programme.desc: Hot Stove (Sports). Baby, it might be cold outside, and the springtime sounds of bats hitting balls are months away. What better way for baseball fans to cure the winter blues than to gather around the «Hot Stove» and warm up to the news of the offseason? MLB Network has all the angles covered for all 30 teams, from trades and free agent signings to the juicy rumors that percolate throughout, especially at the annual Winter Meetings in December. A host of former players, including Joe Magrane, Al Leiter, Sean Casey and Dan Plesac, analyze the news, supplemented by insider information from journalists Jon Heyman, Tom Verducci and Peter Gammons, among others

programme.title: ⋗ Inside the NBA
programme.desc: Inside the NBA (Sports). This Emmy Award-winning studio show, which airs following NBA telecasts on ESPN, is hosted by Ernie Johnson, with analysis from Hall of Famer Charles Barkley and NBA champions Kenny Smith and Shaquille O'Neal. It's a mix of highlights, interviews and hijinks, notably the verbal sparring sessions between the outspoken Barkley and his straight man, Smith. The show also welcomes various guest analysts throughout the season

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ Inside the NBA
programme.desc: Inside the NBA (Sports). This Emmy Award-winning studio show, which airs following NBA telecasts on ESPN, is hosted by Ernie Johnson, with analysis from Hall of Famer Charles Barkley and NBA champions Kenny Smith and Shaquille O'Neal. It's a mix of highlights, interviews and hijinks, notably the verbal sparring sessions between the outspoken Barkley and his straight man, Smith. The show also welcomes various guest analysts throughout the season

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ Inside the NBA
programme.desc: Inside the NBA (Sports). This Emmy Award-winning studio show, which airs following NBA telecasts on ESPN, is hosted by Ernie Johnson, with analysis from Hall of Famer Charles Barkley and NBA champions Kenny Smith and Shaquille O'Neal. It's a mix of highlights, interviews and hijinks, notably the verbal sparring sessions between the outspoken Barkley and his straight man, Smith. The show also welcomes various guest analysts throughout the season

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.title: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ Inside the NBA
programme.desc: Inside the NBA (Sports). This Emmy Award-winning studio show, which airs following NBA telecasts on ESPN, is hosted by Ernie Johnson, with analysis from Hall of Famer Charles Barkley and NBA champions Kenny Smith and Shaquille O'Neal. It's a mix of highlights, interviews and hijinks, notably the verbal sparring sessions between the outspoken Barkley and his straight man, Smith. The show also welcomes various guest analysts throughout the season

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.title: ⋗ Inside the NBA
programme.desc: Inside the NBA (Sports). This Emmy Award-winning studio show, which airs following NBA telecasts on ESPN, is hosted by Ernie Johnson, with analysis from Hall of Famer Charles Barkley and NBA champions Kenny Smith and Shaquille O'Neal. It's a mix of highlights, interviews and hijinks, notably the verbal sparring sessions between the outspoken Barkley and his straight man, Smith. The show also welcomes various guest analysts throughout the season

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.title: ⋗ Inside the NBA
programme.desc: Inside the NBA (Sports). This Emmy Award-winning studio show, which airs following NBA telecasts on ESPN, is hosted by Ernie Johnson, with analysis from Hall of Famer Charles Barkley and NBA champions Kenny Smith and Shaquille O'Neal. It's a mix of highlights, interviews and hijinks, notably the verbal sparring sessions between the outspoken Barkley and his straight man, Smith. The show also welcomes various guest analysts throughout the season

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers.
